rationale: The short thesis remains intact as DDOG continues to show severe relative weakness near the bottom of its daily range (8.3%) on 5.86x relative volume. A recent minor bounce was cleanly rejected at $191.09, just beneath the declining 5-minute 9-EMA ($191.27), followed immediately by a high-volume bearish 1-minute candle closing near its low. With price remaining well below both the 9-EMA and session VWAP ($195.46), holding for a retest and breakdown of the $188.38 session low is warranted.
